## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%), SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%), VXX falling (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -16.44%) — multiple confirmations of risk-on.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX falling (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -16.44%) BELOW TREND. Credit strain flagged: HYG (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +2.07%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +1.64%) ABOVE TREND but HYG/LQD signal shows credit stress rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-accommodative: SPY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +0.53%) ABOVE TREND — Stocks vs Bonds rising. Dollar flat and below trend (Level 27.36 | 1W: -0.07% | 1M: -0.80% → flat | BELOW TREND); Yield curve in RECOVERY.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech/Growth leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%). Financials also strong: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +10.92%); Energy weak: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%). Style: Growth/Momentum showing strength.

5. US vs Global?
US outperformance but global gains broad: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) while EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.09% | 1M: +10.56%) and FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +3.87%) are also strong.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Risk-on breadth with speculative bid: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.35% | 1M: +10.95%), IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +9.14%), IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +12.10%) — speculation index rising.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial metals and precious metals up: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +10.82%), GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.01% | 1M: +0.27%), SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +7.18%). Broad commodity weakness centered in oil.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy under pressure: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -12.83%); natural gas showing RECOVERY: UNG RECOVERY (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -14.44%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Broad equity leadership with SPY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) and XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND; DIVERGENCE minor: XLB in CORRECTION (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +7.49%) and UNG in RECOVERY (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -14.44%).

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor growth/momentum exposure evidenced by XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%); reduce exposure to energy risk via XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%); bonds neutral with TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +0.53%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) and SOXX (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%) if semis momentum holds. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) and BNO (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -12.83%) if oil remains weak.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +10.82%) and SLV (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +7.18%) on industrial/precious metal strength. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -12.83%) and USO/energy complex if demand signals soften.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 28.98 (complacency easing; monitor for reversals), Credit spread ~0.7329 (HYG/LQD signal for credit stress), XLK/XLF 2.9439 (tech vs financials leadership pivot), SPY/TLT level 8.1560 (stocks vs bonds rising).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON — Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, confirmed by VXX falling and Stocks vs Bonds rising. Tech and semis (XLK, SOXX) and growth ETFs (ARKK, QQQ) showing strength. Key risk: credit-stress signal (HYG/LQD) and commodity/oil weakness are divergences to monitor.
